corrections.form_value: Its scope is AI interventions in general, not only generative AI. / Various AI interventions (title says 'AI Interventions'); not limited to generative AI. / Its scope is AI interventions in education broadly (cognitive, social-emotional, academic outcomes), not generative AI and creativity specifically, but its reference list includes four creativity trials.
corrections.source_says: The accessible title identifies AI interventions without specifying which technologies were eligible or included. Crossref and OpenAlex supply no abstract, Semantic Scholar withholds the abstract, and the publisher page returns a client challenge; citations to AI studies do not establish the inclusion criteria. Qualify these statements as: The title concerns AI interventions across cognitive, social-emotional, and academic outcomes; whether the review includes non-generative AI is unconfirmed.
corrections.quote: Effects of AI Interventions Across Cognitive, Social-emotional, and Academic Outcomes: a Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials with Nonlinear Dose–response Evidence
corrections.locator: Crossref API record for DOI 10.1007/s10648-026-10217-5, title and absent abstract (https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1007/s10648-026-10217-5); OpenAlex W7218618536, abstract_inverted_index=null. Checked 2026-10-09.

confirmed: The title explicitly describes a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials, and OpenAlex labels the work a review; design_class=synthesis and context_class=synthesis are supported. No original randomized people study is identified in the accessible records; this is not a full-text confirmation of its absence. Locators: Crossref title; OpenAlex W7218618536, type=review.

The source version is accurately limited to bibliographic metadata. No markdown or PDF is recorded locally; Crossref has no abstract, OpenAlex abstract_inverted_index is null, Semantic Scholar abstract is null with a publisher-elision notice, Europe PMC returns hitCount=0, and the Springer article page returns Client Challenge. Locators: retrieval.json, c110; Crossref DOI record; OpenAlex W7218618536; Semantic Scholar DOI endpoint, openAccessPdf.disclaimer; Europe PMC DOI search; https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10648-026-10217-5. The arXiv title-query API returned HTTP 429 and supplied no source text.
The document title and all six author names match Crossref: Xiaotian Ren, Xinying Li, Luying Gao, Qiuying Wei, Haoning Liu, and Xiao Yu. Locators: Crossref DOI record, title and author.

Educational Psychology Review, volume 38, issue 1, article 128, and online publication date 2026-10-03 match the source; the reference-count field and reference array both contain 220 references. This is a reference count, not a count of included studies. Locators: Crossref DOI record, container-title, volume, issue, article-number, published-online, reference-count, and reference.

The four named 2024 creativity-related papers are present in the reference list: Lee and Chung, Niloy et al., Saritepeci and Yildiz Durak, and Urban et al. Their presence as citations does not confirm their inclusion in a pooled analysis. Locators: Crossref reference keys 10217_CR113, 10217_CR143, 10217_CR166, and 10217_CR185.

Null study/effect-size and participant counts, the empty pooled-estimate list, and the absence of reported outcome statistics are appropriate to the accessible records. No primary text confirms the triage lead of 47 trials, a participant threshold, a creativity-specific estimate, an interval, or a standardizer. Locators: Crossref DOI record, absent abstract; OpenAlex W7218618536, abstract_inverted_index=null; Semantic Scholar DOI endpoint, abstract=null. There are no outcome reported strings to check.

The one-line finding accurately identifies the 2026 meta-analysis, volume 38/article 128, and the four cited 2024 papers, while recording no unverified pooled number. Locators: Crossref published-online, volume, article-number, title, and reference keys 10217_CR113, 10217_CR143, 10217_CR166, and 10217_CR185.

The 22.79-hour number in the notes occurs in Semantic Scholar tldr.text under model tldr@v2.0.0, not in an available abstract; excluding it from the findings is appropriate. The Bian 2025 and Li 2023 reference titles concern engagement/self-efficacy/cognitive load and courseware project performance/perceptions, respectively, and do not mention creativity. Locators: Semantic Scholar paper 90c68008da92c81c531343b33a89251af5dfbb29, tldr; Crossref reference keys 10217_CR17 and 10217_CR118.
summary: The synthesis classification and bibliographic details are supported, but the assertion that the review includes non-generative AI goes beyond the accessible metadata. No original randomized people study was identified, and the unavailable abstract and full text leave study counts, pooled effects, and creativity-specific findings unverified.
